{{Quote|I think you can activate the shields captain. It would appear Stark knows we are here. Get us to the rendezvous."<br />"Yes, sir. If we can. We suffered some collateral damage ourselves.|Qui-Gon Jinn and the captain|<ref name="SW37" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] had the rank of '''captain''' in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], she [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to the negotiations on [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] between the [[Stark Commercial Combine]] and Galactic Republic delegates, which ended with an attack by the Combine that began the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. The Republic delegates retreated to the cruiser, which the captain tried to fly to safety, but the cruiser was damaged and exploded shortly after landing near Republic forces at [[Mount Avos]]. The captain was injured and recuperated while battles continued against the Stark forces. Eventually, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had been part of the delegation planned to return to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to appeal for aid from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. At a Troiken [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the Jedi stole the [[Quicksilver (Iaco Stark)|''Quicksilver'']], the personal ship of the Combine's leader, [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]], with the captain piloting it to Coruscant. While transporting the Jedi [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], the captain was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an electric shock from booby trap set up by Stark.

==Biography==
===Aggressive negotiations===
{{Quote|Can we outrun them?"<br />"Not damaged as we are, and we can't get altitude with them on our tail. This is a diplomatic vessel so we have no weapons and our shields are failing. I'm open to suggestions.|Qui-Gon Jinn and the captain|<ref name="SW37" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="SW37" /> in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], she [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a Republic delegation to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] aboard a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]], where they hoped to negotiate with the [[Stark Commercial Combine]], who had been attacking [[Transport/Legends|transports]] carrying the healing substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], which had become scarce. The delegation included [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Senator [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was also in attendance, although he arrived on his own [[Trade Federation shuttle|shuttle]] with a compliment of [[HKB-3 hunter-killer droid]]s.<ref name="SW37" />

[[File:Captain_and_Jinn.png|thumb|right|250px|The captain and Qui-Gon Jinn]]
The negotiations ended abruptly when the Combine's leader [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] attacked the delegation and used a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] virus to sabotage the incoming Republic [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|fleet]] led by the rogue [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] Senator [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], beginning the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. Tyvokka was [[Death/Legends|mortally]] injured by Gunray's [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the ambush, and the Republic delegates escaped the chaotic scene and retreated to the ''Consular''-class cruiser. Valorum used the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to send a transmission to coordinate a rendezvous with Tarkin, while the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] began preparing it for takeoff.<ref name="SW37" />

After Gunray's shuttle was destroyed by the Combine, Jinn told the captain to activate the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and head to the rendezvous, as their presence was clearly known to the enemy. The captain expressed hope that they could escape, as the ship had suffered collateral damage from the destruction of the shuttle. Once the ship took flight, Jinn spotted another vessel, ''[[Blue 9]]'', that he deduced had destroyed the Trade Federation shuttle, and asked the captain if they could outrun it. The captain explained that their ship and its shields were too damaged to do so, being a diplomatic vessel without weapons. Jinn decided to see what the other Jedi had to suggest. Together, the Jedi&mdash;aside from the newly deceased Tyvokka&mdash;used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to create the illusion to ''Blue 9''{{'s}} pilot that he was surrounded by enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], causing him to cease pursuing the cruiser and eject.<ref name="SW37" />

===Under siege===
{{Quote|We'll have to take one of Stark's ''[ships]''. Has our pilot recovered?|Plo Koon, trying to coordinate the plan to get Valorum to Coruscant|<ref name="SW38" />}}
The ''Consular''-class cruiser crash landed at the rendezvous point near [[Mount Avos]], where Tarkin's forces were escaping Stark's army by fleeing into the mountain's caves. Knowing the ship was about to explode, its passengers quickly fled, with Koon carrying the wounded captain. The Jedi continued to hold her as he took shelter behind some rocks from the inferno. The captain stood back up as the Jedi discussed their next moves with Tarkin, with Koon suggesting that they enter the caves for safety. The pilot spent the subsequent [[Second Battle of Qotile|battle]] against the Stark forces recovering.<ref name="SW38" />

When the Jedi began planning to ferry Valorum to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to plea for support, Koon asked if the captain was sufficiently recovered, to which Gallia responded in the affirmative. Tarkin's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Jace Dallin]] created a [[Third Battle of Qotile|diversion]] for the Stark forces while all of the Jedi aside from Koon escaped through an access shaft, with Jinn and Gallia stealing a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] to travel to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. They planned to steal one of the Stark Combine's ships, believing it would not be affected by the virus that had been unleashed on the Republic ships.<ref name="SW38" />

===Death===
{{Quote|She's dead. You and Minister Gunray must get to the escape pods immediately.|Adi Gallia speaking of the captain|<ref name="SW39" />}}
[[File:Pilot_electrocuted.png|thumb|right|300px|The captain was killed by a booby trap aboard the ''Quicksilver'']]
Koon revealed to Gallia that Stark kept a personal ship,<ref name="SW38">[[Star Wars (1998) 38|''Star Wars'' (1998) 38]]</ref> the [[Quicksilver (Iaco Stark)|''Quicksilver'']],<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|63|Quicksilver}}</ref> which the group could steal. The Jedi [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], having arrived independently to Troiken, set off an explosion near the spaceport, allowing the captain, Gallia, Gunray, and Valorum to head for the ''Quicksilver'' while Jinn and Kenobi returned to Mount Avos. While killing the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] guarding the ship, Koon asked the captain how quickly she could start flying, to which she responded that it could be done as soon as Gunray was onboard. She also expressed confusion as to who had caused the explosion. The pilot quickly flew the ''Quicksilver'' away from Troiken to reach the Coruscant, seated next to Gallia in the pilot's chair.<ref name="SW38" />

The group hoped to analyze the ''Quicksilver''{{'s}} navigation computer to find a way to counteract the virus that had infected the Republic ships. However, as the ship neared Coruscant and the captain took the ''Quicksilver'' out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], a booby trap activated, electrocuting the captain and killing her instantly. Valorum rushed in to see what happened and saw the captain's smouldering body, to which Gallia suggested that Stark had a hidden code in his ship that sprung the trap in its absence. Gallia, Gunray, and Valorum ran to the ships' [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and were able to land safely on Coruscant as the ''Quicksilver'' exploded.<ref name="SW39" />

==Personality and traits==
The captain was willing to accept suggestions from the Jedi in order to escape the Stark Combine's forces.<ref name="SW37" /> She served the Republic during the war at the cost of her own life.<ref name="SW39" /> She had [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="SW37" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|How quickly can you get us aloft?"<br />"As quickly as you can get the Neimoidian on.|Plo Koon and the captain|<ref name="SW38" />}}
The captain was capable of flying a ''Consular''-class cruiser<ref name="SW37" /> and was able to quickly fly the ''Quicksilver'' after encountering it.<ref name="SW38" />

==Equipment==
The captain wore the blue uniform<ref name="SW37" /> of the Judicial Forces,<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> and wielded a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] during the Stark Hyperspace War.<ref name="SW38" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic captain first appeared in flashbacks in the [[Star Wars (1998) 37|thirty-seventh issue]] of the [[1998]] [[Star Wars: Republic|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue, which was the second in the [[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War|''The Stark Hyperspace War'']] arc, was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Davidé Fabbri]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="SW37" /> on [[December 19]], [[2001]].<ref name="Date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53932/star_wars_1998_37|text=Star Wars (1998) #37}}</ref>
